flaws.text: Dependency section: "Function- and class-level edge endpoints are resolved to their owning file's layer rather than dropped", while Success Criterion 9 says "no function- or class-level node is read". Resolving an endpoint to a layer reads the node. The fix derives the owning file from the node id string, which makes both hold. **VALID**: self-contradiction. Needs: document alone. Found by the original review (F001 "Function/class edge-endpoint resolution conflicts with the architecture's 'not read' rule"), so a control.
